_note: Two generic USB wrist cameras. They report the SAME serial (200901010001), so identity is the USB port path: a serial here would match both and resolve_slots would refuse. Re-plug into a different port and this file must be updated. exposure_dynamic_framerate=0 pins the frame rate: with it on, these cameras drop to 7.6 fps in dim light to buy exposure. power_line_frequency=1 is 50 Hz mains.
